replacement_order: SHA256 of 20260917:replacement:<qid> over the 840 previously unprocessed long QA
skip_policy: User explicitly requests skipping ambiguous/unsuitable cases and replacing until 60 source-complete questions. Preserve every disposition. Incomplete evidence or unsupported references are not admitted.
acceptance: All necessary answer facts and relations supported by traceable original frames/subtitles; question has a usable standalone short-answer rubric; positive grounded source audit with valid citations plus Codex review. Answer correctness alone is never the sufficiency criterion.
reference_visibility: Localization and grounded rubric audit see the official reference. Independent observer sees only the short question, actual frames and source subtitles. Generated captions are localization-only.
result_type: AI-audited curated evidence-complete development/diagnostic set, not human gold or unbiased natural benchmark sample
future_test_policy: Exclude all accessed development and replacement video histories from future held-out test selection. Existing original manifests remain unchanged; write new exclusion manifest.

projection.oversized_intervals: Split each nominated span into contiguous <=60-second subwindows before adding context; retain the full nominated span. The limit of 8 applies to nominations, not derived subwindows. Frame budget remains 64; any resulting insufficiency is grounds for exclusion.

audio: Use original provided SRT where available; no synthetic subtitle treated as original evidence, no ASR in this run
source_summaries: Full original SRT for localization and at most 40 candidate caption segments from lexical retrieval plus temporal coverage. For explicit first/order scope, source SRT can be supplied in full to audit when needed. Original frames are still required for visual claims.
prior_eight: Reuse previously source-supported 8 pilot adjudications with complete pointers and checksums; unresolved and unsuitable 4 remain excluded. Do not relabel previous raw responses.
change_note: Normalize oversized model nominations after v1.0 technical failures; preserve failed records and reuse cached calls. No admission threshold change.
